name: Remediate Dashboard API N+1 Query Bottleneck
task_description: Diagnose and optimize GET /v1/dashboard latency from 4200ms to sub-500ms p95 SLA by replacing an N+1 query loop with batch eager-loading and composite database indexing.

guardrails.require_empirical_baseline: Baseline benchmark must precede any query or code modifications (no blind tuning)
guardrails.enforce_surgical_diff: Apply minimal batching and indexing edits without redesigning unrelated domain logic
guardrails.preserve_behavioral_invariants: Optimization must preserve 100% existing domain semantics and output payload contract
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Record database access invariants and query budget limits in ADR and completion report

invariants: Baseline benchmark must precede any code or query changes
Preserve 100% existing domain and contract behavior with zero regression
Evidence-backed before/after latency comparison required showing compliance with SLA
Record performance budget rules and N+1 prevention patterns in completion report Section 5
